_comment: Third-party baseline implementations we run against our dataset.
Nothing here is vendored into this repo: `setup.sh` clones each entry into
baselines/vendor/<key>/ at the pinned commit, and baselines/vendor/ is gitignored.
Pin every repo. A baseline whose commit moves under us is not a baseline.
`paper_commit` is what the paper's numbers belong to when it differs from HEAD;
null means the authors did not tag one and we pinned the HEAD we first cloned.

patchagent.paper: PatchAgent: A Practical Program Repair Agent Mimicking Human Expertise (USENIX Security '25)
patchagent.notes: Production fork; the paper's artifact is at https://osf.io/8k2ac and has diverged. Record which one produced any number we publish.

san2patch.paper: Logs In, Patches Out: Automated Vulnerability Repair via Tree-of-Thought LLM Analysis (USENIX Security '25)
san2patch.notes: USENIX artifact-evaluated (Available). Needs san2patch-benchmark alongside it.

san2patch-benchmark.notes: THE high-value asset. 43 VulnLoc cases with config/build/test scripts AND separate config_func/build_func/test_func functional-test scripts + PoC inputs. 37 of its 43 cases are in our dataset. This is where our missing C/C++ functional tests come from.

looprepair.paper: Well Begun is Half Done: Location-Aware and Trace-Guided Iterative Automated Vulnerability Repair (ICSE '26, arXiv:2512.20203)
looprepair.notes: No LICENSE file in the repo — do NOT vendor or redistribute any of it. Run in place from vendor/ only. Ships VulnLoc+ (VulnLoc + 12 CrashRepair cases); all 38 of its cases are in our dataset.
